actions.reason: Shop listens on 5099 but LB/README require 5050; connection refused on 5050.

root_causes.evidence: Shop log showed listening on 127.0.0.1:5099 while LB requires 5050; smoke tests got connection refused on 5050.

report.summary: config.yaml had app.port set to 5099 instead of 5050, so the shop was unreachable by the load balancer. I changed it to 5050 and restarted the shop. All 5 smoke tests pass, including checkout with the order persisted.
